It’s where your creating moments. The ones your family and friends remember forever. What We Do “Summerhill Pools • Outdoor Living did a fantastic job of building our pool. They were very easy to work with, everyone is nice and professional.” – Dana Krieg Make your Dallas backyard legendary Explore our curated project gallery and discover how our expert team can bring your dream outdoor space to life with craftsmanship, attention to detail, and an elevated service experience. View gallery Your Process, Detailed When you partner with Summerhill Pools • Outdoor Living for your pools and outdoor living needs in Dallas, you’ll experience a refreshingly transparent journey. We believe in keeping you informed and involved. Let’s walk through what you can expect: Onsite Consultation During the initial in-person consultation, we learn about your vision, lifestyle, and design goals while also evaluating the lay of the land—including elevations, yard access, and site conditions. This allows us to create a custom pool design that’s both beautiful and buildable. Design In the outdoor transformation phase , our Landscape Architect uses advanced technology that combines 100 years of industry experience. This allows us to create customized designs that meet high aesthetic standards and cater to your specific needs. The design process begins with translating your vision into a detailed layout, incorporating key features, materials, and architectural elements. We use 3D renderings and scaled drawings to ensure the design aligns with your property and project goals. Estimation After carefully examining every aspect of the project to ensure no detail is overlooked, we provide a cost estimate for the build. We are dedicated to transparency, offering a detailed cost breakdown to include everything from pricing, information, building scope, utility locations, and timelines upfront, to help minimize unexpected costly change orders by thoroughly analyzing every aspect of your project. Showroom Visit Visiting our showroom allows you to see your custom 3D design come to life on the big screen. It’s a time to review layout options, discuss pricing, and collaborate on the details that will bring your backyard vision into focus. You have the opportunity to make real-time changes to your design to make sure you are 100% in love with your backyard transformation. Final Revisions & Material Selections Working with our skilled design consultant provides a personalized experience for choosing materials that will shape the look and functionality of your future pool. This collaborative process lets you express your preferences, ensuring the final result aligns with your vision. Dive In Pool and backyard transformation begins. Depending on the complexity of your pool design and backyard additions like a kitchen, firepit, putting green and turf, this process with take 12 to 16 weeks. Your trusted pool & outdoor living company In Dallas since 1989 Summerhill Pools • Outdoor Living is accredited by the BBB with an A+ rating, so Dallas homeowners know they can trust our customer service as well as our craftsmanship. With a longstanding commitment to excellence and a passion for innovative design, we continue to redefine outdoor living for discerning homeowners every day. As a boutique, family-owned firm with deep local roots, we’re committed to building a legacy of exceptional pool design, backyard renovations, and reliable service. We deliver the kind of personalized care and quality that sets a new standard in the pool industry and backyard construction. design your dream outdoors Our experience with Summerhill Pools • Outdoor Living was absolutely wonderful.
